# Casper agent skills and MCP servers

> AI-agent tooling for Casper: the CSPR.cloud, CSPR.click and CSPR.trade agent skills from MAKE; Odra's Claude Code plugin, whose skills and references cover writing, testing and deploying Odra contracts; and casper-mcp, an MCP server with 87 tools for querying and building on Casper.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from msanlisavas/casper-mcp@c89b4e6, odradev/odradev-plugins@d66e542.
